## Patient: Amina

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:** 51-year-old male presenting with seropositive Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) exhibiting erosive joint changes. Reports morning stiffness exceeding 1 hour and symmetric MCP joint swelling. Anti-CCP levels are elevated at 250 U/mL.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient demonstrates positive morning stiffness, bilateral MCP joint swelling, and normal range of motion. Palpation reveals tenderness in the affected joints.

**Management Plan:** Initiate NSAIDs as prescribed for pain management. Recommend physical therapy focusing on range of motion exercises and strengthening to mitigate joint instability.
